about.text: semi-hard cow's milk cheese made in Cornwall from the milk of Friesian cows. Before being left to mature, this cheese is wrapped in nettle leaves to form an edible, though mouldy, rind.

sources.text: wrapped in nettle leaves; mould-ripened rind
